Logto.//ManagementApi: Machine-to-machine app with Logto Management API access, used by account deletion. Leave ClientId/ClientSecret blank to disable deletion.

Cors.//: Browser-client origins allowed to call /api/v1 directly. In Development these default to the local frontend ports if omitted; set them explicitly in production (e.g. the deployed hub + Meltho + Mno domains).

RateLimit.//: Public rate limit, per caller. A caller is the authenticated user when there is one, otherwise the client IP. Both keys are optional; these are the code defaults. Note the frontends' server-side render fetches all arrive from one address, so SSR shares a single bucket while browser traffic partitions per visitor — that is the bucket to raise first if 429s appear.

TrustedProxies.//: Networks whose X-Forwarded-For is believed. Optional; the code default is loopback + the RFC 1918 ranges, which covers the compose bridge. Narrow this to the proxy's own address in any deployment where the API is reachable without going through Caddy — an over-wide list lets a caller choose their own rate-limit partition.
